protocol.hypothesis: After scheduled Bank of Russia key-rate releases, the first full hourly candle has a larger absolute return and volume than the same hour one week earlier; its direction may continue or reverse over the following 1, 3, or 6 bars.
protocol.event_snapshot: events.json: 23 scheduled key-rate decisions from 2024-02-16 through 2026-10-23; planned release at 13:30 Europe/Moscow; unscheduled decisions excluded because their prior schedule and precise publication time are not verified
protocol.parameter_rationale: Both directional responses and short, medium, end-of-session holding windows are fixed before outcomes. A 1H source is the finest frozen broad-universe series available for 2024-2026; 4H and 1D bars straddle 13:30 and cannot isolate the initial reaction.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and 1H candles, next-open filled. Event response is additionally compared with the same hour exactly seven calendar days earlier on the same stock when both candles exist.
protocol.signal_rule: The 13:00-14:00 bar straddles the planned 13:30 release and is never used as a trading signal. Observe the completed 14:00-15:00 Moscow bar. If close > open, continuation is long and reversal is short; if close < open, vice versa; equal is no signal. Place the order at the 15:00 bar open; close after 1, 3, or 6 completed hourly bars at the next open. Missing 14:00 or 15:00 bars cause that event-symbol to be skipped. Published rate level, later press conference and actual release timestamp are not used to infer surprise or direction.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research ranking only; no automatic paper selection from scheduled-event history; event-level dependence must be evaluated across dates, not treated as independent stock observations
limitations: 13:30 is scheduled publication time, not a verified actual publication timestamp for each historic event
No contemporaneous consensus forecast or ex-ante surprise measure; rate changes and policy text are not classified
Only 23 scheduled events; stock returns on the same date are correlated, so cross-sectional count is not 23 times number of stocks independent observations
Results are an event study and research-only; not a claim that the rate decision caused an observed stock move

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
